subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should OpenClaw accept same-agent owner-scoped live orphan transcript hits as visible when session visibility permits but the combined session store has no entry?
rationale: The code shape is narrow and tested, but the change deliberately alters which private transcript snippets may surface through memory tools after upgrade, and that privacy boundary overlaps active broader recall work.

options.title: Accept Scoped Fallback
options.body: Approve this narrow same-agent fallback while preserving cross-agent and basename-only fail-closed behavior.

options.title: Require Gateway Replay Proof
options.body: Ask for a live gateway memory_search or memory-wiki replay with refreshed indexing before deciding the boundary.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recall
options.body: Pause this PR and resolve the behavior only through the broader default-off private recall direction.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Fallback
recommendation.body: Approve this narrow same-agent fallback while preserving cross-agent and basename-only fail-closed behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Their active private-recall PR is the closest maintainer-owned product direction that must align with this transcript visibility choice.
